value.name: present life tenancy document
value.description: Asha brings in the life tenancy paperwork, indicating there is now something to sign.
evidence: Today there was something to sign. Asha had brought it in a folder.

value.name: explain life tenancy terms
value.description: Asha explains that the life tenancy gives Rosa use of the third-floor rooms without rent, service, or residency requirements and is a gift from Mrs. Serrano with the beneficiaries' consent.
evidence: "The life tenancy," Asha said, "gives Rosa the use of the third-floor rooms for as long as she wishes them. It does not require her to live there. It does not require her to pay rent. It does not require her to perform any service in the house. It is not contingent on her employment, which, as of the date of Mrs. Serrano's death, ended. It is a gift, made by your mother, with the consent of both of you in your capacity as residual beneficiaries, and accepted, if she chooses to accept it, by Rosa."
value.time_hint: as of the date of Mrs. Serrano's death

value.name: rosa accepts tenancy
value.description: Rosa states that she chooses to accept the life tenancy.
evidence: "I choose to accept it," Rosa said.

value.name: witness signature procedure
value.description: Asha says she will witness Rosa's signature and asks Daniel and Lucia to state on the record that they understand and do not contest the tenancy.
evidence: "I will witness her signature when we reach that point. Before we do, I want each of you to say, on the record, that you understand what the life tenancy is and that you do not contest it."

value.name: daniel consents on record
value.description: Daniel says he understands the life tenancy and does not contest it.
evidence: "I understand," Daniel said. "I do not contest it."

value.name: lucia consents on record
value.description: Lucia says she understands the life tenancy, does not contest it, and expresses approval.
evidence: "I understand," Lucia said. "I do not contest it. I am glad of it."

value.name: rosa raises concern about status
value.description: Before signing, Rosa asks whether accepting the tenancy would still leave her as the housekeeper in a personal sense rather than as staff.
evidence: "Rosa, do you have any questions before you sign?"

"If I take this," she said, "I am still your mother's housekeeper in the sense that I knew her better than anyone alive in this room except you two, and possibly better than that. I am not your mother's housekeeper in the sense that I will clean this house. I want to be clear that the life tenancy is not a way of keeping me here as staff.
